title: Invertibility of a characterized second localization map
statement: For the rings and models of lem-pc-second-localization-iso, every characterized coefficient map is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Use the same flat resolution and comparison as in the existence step. Localization makes every denominator of B a unit after extension to Bp, so the comparison is an isomorphism on localized homology. Tensor associativity transports its inverse to D; the generator formula and IsSecondLocalizationMap.ext identify the transported map with the given characterized map, proving it is an isomorphism.

theorem secondLocalization_hom_isIso
    (T : Submonoid B) [IsLocalization T Bp] (hflat : (algebraMap B Bp).Flat) (i : ℤ)
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
    (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A Bp Q D)
    (f : (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).obj (L.cohomology i) ⟶
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] Bp) D)).obj (K.cohomology i))
    (hf : IsSecondLocalizationMap R A B Bp D hflat Q L K i f) : IsIso f
